name: Luis Enrique Martínez
scopeNote: Narrowed on 2026-11-04: only Barcelona 2014-17 and PSG 2023- are counted; both Spain spells (2018-19, 2019-22) are excluded and their sources stay in the file as context with verified false. Counted spells: Barcelona 2014-17 (2015 treble, MSN), Spain 2018-19 and 2019-22 (Euro 2020 semi-final, 2022 World Cup), PSG from 2023 (Champions League 2025 and 2026, still in post: contract extended to 2030 on 2026-09-04). Narrowed to spells with titles or tier A-B tactical coverage. Roma 2011-12 and Celta 2013-14 are context only. Style terms used by sources: juego de posición / positional play with a vertical edge (Coaches' Voice), 'a more direct approach' at Barcelona (Scotsman, 2016, Messi quoted: 'more vertical'), 'jeu de position 2.0' / 3-2-2-3 / 3-1-2-2-2-0 at PSG (Lefaucheux via CulturePSG). Popular label 'tiki-taka' does not fit his Barcelona per these sources. Marking: Barcelona changed set-piece defending from zonal to man (Bleacher Report 2014, tier C); PSG set pieces use a mixed zone (CulturePSG 2024); in open play PSG presses player-to-player against build-up (Coaches' Voice 2025 final) while Spain used a mid-block 4-1-4-1. Spain first spell dates: appointment 2018-07-09 (The Local, verified); the 2019 break and 2022 exit dates come from search summaries, not mined pages (see openQuestions). Barcelona exit date also unverified from a mined page. Excluded-spell dates are partial (months/years) because no day was needed for context-only spells; the podcast articleDate 2023 is approximate (page shows only fetch date).
openQuestions: Spain spell dates: appointment 2018-07-09 verified (thelocal.es). Stepped down 2019-06 (family/health, Robert Moreno interim) and returned 2019-11-19, and left 2022-12-08 (search result: ESPN says leaves post two days after Morocco loss; ESPN page was empty when mined). Barcelona last match 2017-05-27 / contract end 2017-06-30 and announcement 2017-03-01 are from memory, not mined.
Contested label: some press say Spain 'sacked' him in Dec 2022, others that he left at contract end.
Tactical coverage for Barcelona is mostly tier C (no Zonal Marking / Spielverlagerung page mined); Michael Cox/The Athletic and Zonal Marking pieces were not found in searches.
PSG 2025/26 and 2026/27 (current season to Nov 2026) have thin tier A-B coverage; TFA match breakdowns of PSG-Newcastle, PSG-Chelsea 2025/26 exist but were not mined.
Pressing at Barcelona in the 2015 treble: no tier A-B source mined states the press scheme (zonal vs man).
